name: Popotan Fan Disc Issho ni A-SO-BO
original_name: ぽぽたんファンディスク いっしょにA・SO・BO
source:
Among the other goodies disc includes two mini-scenarios:
1. Leave it to Nono「ののにおまかせ」
Main character Chris is predicted death with 1000% accuracy unless he has sex with a girl in glasses over this time.
2. Mii witch girl battle「みいの魔女っ子大作戦」
Mii-chan is a magical girl of love and justice. Store manager gets missing, so Chris has nothing better to do than accompany Mii-chan in her adventures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
其他好东西光盘包括两个迷你场景：
1.交给诺诺“ののにおまかせ”
主角克里斯除非在这段时间内与戴眼镜的女孩发生性关系，否则他的死亡预测准确率是1000%。
2. Mii魔女战斗“みいの魔女っ子大作戦”
小美是一位充满爱与正义的魔法少女。店长失踪了，克里斯除了陪伴小美踏上冒险之旅之外，无事可做。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
